title: Early Prediction of Cross-Service Implementation Scope: Evidence and Limits from Multiple Microservice Projects
title_zh: 跨服务实现范围的早期预测：来自多个微服务项目的证据与局限

paragraphs.en: 研究发现早期证据难以可靠预测微服务跨服务实现范围，更适合轻量级范围分诊而非自动化判定。 Microservice architectures aim to localize change, yet feature requests may require implementation across service boundaries. We investigate how well such downstream scope can be anticipated before implementation begins. Using issue--pull-request--commit traceability and implementation evidence corrected through targeted human adjudication, we reconstruct 866 repository-traceable feature requests from 13 open-source microservice projects and map their implementations to validated service boundaries. Cross-service changes occur in 101 requests (11.7%) and exhibit broader implementation footprints, particularly higher code churn, but no clear difference in lead time. Pre-implementation evidence provides limited cross-project predictive signal: the strongest leave-one-system-out model reaches a project-macro Macro-F1 of 0.484, but its advantage over the majority baseline is not significant after Holm correction and is sensitive to small evaluation folds. A local LLM offers no reliable improvement over classical models. Downstream workload is substantially harder to estimate, as learned models do not consistently outperform training-fold median baselines. A simple service-mention heuristic also performs comparably to learned scope triage. These findings show that early feature-request evidence is more useful for lightweight cross-service scope triage than for automated scope determination or precise workload estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现，早期证据难以可靠预测微服务的跨服务实现范围，因此更适合用于轻量级的范围分诊，而非自动化判定。微服务架构旨在将变更局部化，但功能请求可能需要跨越服务边界进行实现。 我们研究了在实现开始之前，这类下游范围能在多大程度上被预测。 利用「问题—拉取请求—提交」的可追溯性以及通过针对性人工裁定修正后的实现证据，我们从 13 个开源微服务项目中重构了 866 个可追溯至仓库的功能请求，并将其实现映射到经验证的服务边界。 跨服务变更出现在 101 个请求中（占 11.7%），并且表现出更广泛的实现足迹，尤其是更高的代码变更量，但在交付周期上没有明显差异。 实现前的证据只能提供有限的跨项目预测信号：最强的留一系统交叉验证模型达到了 0.484 的项目级宏平均 Macro-F1，但在 Holm 校正后，其相对于多数类基线的优势并不显著，并且对较小的评估折敏感。 本地大语言模型（LLM）相较于经典模型没有带来可靠的提升。 下游工作量的估计要困难得多，因为学习到的模型并不能稳定地优于训练折中位数基线。 一个简单的服务提及启发式方法的表现也与学习型的范围分诊相当。 这些发现表明，早期的功能请求证据对于轻量级的跨服务范围分诊比对于自动化的范围判定或精确的工作量估计更为有用。
